about.title: About This Edition
about.description1: Romance of the Three Kingdoms (三国演义) is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature.
about.description2: Written by Luo Guanzhong during the Ming Dynasty (14th century), it chronicles the turbulent Three Kingdoms period (169-280 AD).
about.description3: This platform presents the complete 120 chapters, allowing you to explore both the literary narrative and the historical context behind the stories.

about.title: About Three Kingdoms Platform
about.intro: The Three Kingdoms Digital Platform is a comprehensive web application for exploring the Three Kingdoms period (169-280 AD) of Chinese history.
about.multiSourceIntro: Our platform uniquely presents information from multiple sources, explicitly distinguishing between:
about.source1: Historical records (三国志 - Records of the Three Kingdoms)
about.source2: Literary interpretation (三国演义 - Romance of the Three Kingdoms)
about.attribution: Every fact is attributed to its source with clear reliability indicators, allowing you to understand the difference between historical fact and literary dramatization.
about.technology: Built with modern web technologies including React, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL, hosted on Microsoft Azure.
